name: Facebook Integration
description: Prepare the church's public Facebook Page and optional Meta Pixel settings. Tracking and embedded content remain inactive.
author: Elkins Park Reformed Presbyterian Church

settings.label: Public Facebook Page URL
settings.help: The church's public https://www.facebook.com/... address. Leave blank until available.

settings.label: Facebook Page ID (optional)
settings.help: The numeric Page ID, if supplied by Meta. This is not an access token.

settings.label: Meta Pixel ID (optional)
settings.help: Store the numeric Pixel ID for future public-website integration. Saving or enabling this plugin does not activate tracking.
